# Auto-reboot when needed, never when disruptive + widget indicator (cosmo)

classic-laddie converges continuously but never reboots, so the booted generation drifts from
the deployed one (kernel/systemd skew — real update incompatibilities). Build: reboot only when
NEEDED, executed only when QUIET, visible always, escalating when blocked.

## Part 1 — host module (new, e.g. modules/common/auto-reboot.nix, enabled for classic-laddie)

1. **Needed-detection**: a oneshot (hourly timer + triggered after cosmo-rebuild completes)
   comparing the booted world against the deployed one — kernel, initrd, kernel-modules,
   systemd paths under /run/booted-system vs /run/current-system. Read nixpkgs'
   `system.autoUpgrade.allowReboot` implementation for the canonical comparison and mirror it.
   State file: `/var/lib/reboot-pending/state` — written with the first-detected timestamp when
   divergence appears, removed when clean (post-reboot it clears itself). Also record each
   blocked attempt: timestamp + reason, same directory.
2. **The quiet-window attempt**: a daily timer ~04:45 (after restic's 03:52, before the Storage
   Box snapshots) that, IF pending, checks blockers and either reboots (`systemctl reboot`,
   NON-forced — inhibitor locks are honored by design) or records why not:
   - a klaus agent run in progress: any `~patrick/.klaus/sessions/*/runs/*.json` with a running
     status (read as root, parse defensively);
   - an interactive session active or idle under 60 minutes (`loginctl`/`w` — document the
     imperfection tersely);
   - `cosmo-rebuild.service` or the restic backup unit currently active.
   Every blocked attempt is journaled AND recorded in the state dir with its reason — the widget
   reads it.
3. Comments terse; the module's doc comment states the philosophy in two lines: reboot when the
   booted and deployed worlds split; only when nothing that matters is running; never silently
   deferred forever — visibility is the backstop.

## Part 2 — widget indicator (extends #749's merged module)

Same single batched ssh in the waybar converge script additionally reads the reboot-pending
state (existence, first-detected age, last blocked reason). Display:

- pending: a distinct indicator on the module (glyph + class `reboot-pending`), tooltip line
  "reboot pending since <relative>, last attempt blocked: <reason>".
- pending older than 7 days: escalated class (`reboot-overdue`, amber-family) — the operator's
  cue that the machine has been trying and failing to find a quiet moment.
- Precedence stated explicitly in the script: rebuilding > failed > unreachable >
  reboot-overdue > reboot-pending > current > stale.
- Extend the existing test file's canned-input pattern with the new states.

## Verification

Match cosmo CI, run the same evals for hosts and the home profile, PASTE final lines. Unit-test
the blocker script with canned inputs (running-agent json, idle/busy loginctl output) per the
house pattern; note plainly that the live reboot path is verified post-merge by the state file
appearing at the next kernel-diverging deploy.

Normal PR flow; merge nothing yourself.
